deepseek.selection: First three consecutive complete layers with overlapping displayed events and inter-layer gaps below 30% of summed layer envelopes
deepseek.boundary: YAML-marked units, not scheduler steps. Selected structural-event population, not the entire raw profiler.

qwen.selection: First three exact replay launches, joined to recorded step identity
qwen.boundary: Associated-device envelopes are not host scheduling time, busy time, or full step membership. Launch row is an evidence comparison, not an extra lane in the exported timeline.
